content.title: What did Muslims Day do in July?
content.subtitle: Quietly transforming the lives of millions of believers!
content.body:
In the dead of night when the world is fast asleep, or amidst the relentless hustle of a sweltering afternoon—a gentle, compassionate reminder lights up a phone screen: "Perform Miswak before Wudu and prepare for Salah." It is never just about prayer times; amidst the deep pull of worldly pursuits, the app consistently reminds users to send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ and revitalizes the heart with calls to repentance and Istighfar. To make idle moments blessed, it offers morning and evening Masnoon Duas, Dhikr, and serene Quranic recitations. In this chaotic life, who can truly quantify the peace these small remembrances of the Lord bring to countless hearts? Throughout July, Muslims Day stood as a trusted companion at every step, helping users become better Muslims.

The Yearning Call to Millions of Prayers and Remembrances

Throughout July, these messages of closeness to Allah reached nearly 1.1 million users. With a daily average of over 2.1 million times—and more than 61 million times across the entire month—reminders for noble deeds like Salah, Dua, Durood, Istighfar, and Quran recitation touched people's hearts. Some stepped away from urgent tasks, while others paused mid-commute to answer the call and prostrate before their Lord. The Muslims Day app reached nearly 100,000 new users, all actively striving to grow into a better Muslim with each passing day.

A Blessed Investment in Eternal Time

In this single month, users spent nearly 480,000 hours on the app—the equivalent of roughly 55 years of human life! SubhanAllah! Every day, people opened the app an average of 14.3 million times with the intention of performing good deeds—whether to prepare for Salah, recite the Quran, or soothe a tired soul with morning and evening Dhikr. Rather than being lost to mindless scrolling, these precious moments were invested in the eternal scales for the Akhirah.

Beyond core app features, we actively organize specialized webinars to nurture spiritual and mental growth. Two sessions have already concluded: "Productive Muslim" and "Islamic Solutions for Protection Against Jinn, Black Magic, and the Evil Eye." We are planning more webinars on vital topics so everyone can learn, understand, and practice the Deen more deeply in daily life.

The Blessed Caravan Sustained by Silent Sacrifices

Muslims Day alone does not claim the reward for this profound impact; standing tirelessly behind the scenes are our beloved Muslims Day Ansar members. Today, thanks to the sincere support of the 595 dedicated Ansar brothers and sisters walking alongside us, the path for millions of Muslims to grow spiritually every day has become smoother. Yet, in our journey to quench the spiritual thirst of millions more, the road ahead remains steep and challenging. To sustain this service seamlessly and amplify its reach threefold, we need at least 2,000 dedicated Ansar members.

footer_button.hint: You can play a unique role in this noble caravan spreading the light of Deen to millions worldwide. To write your name in this boundless stream of rewards—from millions preparing for Salah, fasting, sending Durood, reciting Dhikr, and making Masnoon Duas—join today as an 'Ansar'.
